# control vs 3 candidates · tpl-support (support model sweep)
"does any candidate answer better than the control, at what cost?"

No recommendation was written: no analysis has been generated over this campaign.

Request settings on tpl-support were not confirmed as sent, so the judge or the simulated user there may have run on other settings than asked.

Each cost figure reflects the provider routing of the runs it was measured on, not the model alone.

No call is recorded yet: a person decides, over code's readings.
